_comment: Current probes (Strategy keeps this up to date). name -> level (relative to driver_personal/chicago), optional build (exe folder, default build-dev). python driver_personal/probes.py sync publishes each as a self-contained copy in <Desktop>/Driver Probe Tests/NAME (OneDrive -> laptop).

city selector.what: Two-page city selector: page 1 'Driver 1 cities' (Miami, SF, LA, NY, Newtown, Interview, Training), page 2 'Driver 2 cities' (Chicago day/night; Havana/Las Vegas/Rio greyed). Chicago = b16b: FPS improvement, Miami's cars by day (correct damage dents + damaged-car textures), D2-style night, minimap centred, own sky, trench-curve flip fixed, more of D2's road network with traffic; Play Again/quit freezes fixed on all maps; b16: lakeshore fixes (cars drown properly instead of getting stuck under the street; raised Lake Shore Drive deck joined up).

sky d2.what: C46 sky test: same as 'city selector' (b16) but Chicago's sky built like Driver 2's: the skyline band starts higher (larger, less squeezed) and D2's mirrored reflection rows appear below the horizon. Compare the sky with 'city selector'.

smooth loading.what: C45 loading test: Chicago DAY with the new corridor chunk layout (b15 + corridors). In route tests it cut loading stalls from 9 to 1 on 6 routes, but at one area switch a dark triangle can flash against the sky for about a second. Judge: is driving smoother (fewer short freezes) and is the flash acceptable? Night = b16b.

diagonals.what: C37 diagonal surfaces test: Chicago DAY where diagonal embankments, trench walls and bridge-deck edges were square steps; now 165 cells use diagonal halves (D2-like). Judge: do diagonal edges look/drive right (no staircase bumps)? Night = b16b.

d2 cars.what: Driver 2 cars + Chicago music: Chicago DAY traffic and police are Driver 2's own Chicago cars (your car stays a Miami car); Chicago plays Driver 2's own Chicago music (day track by day, night track at night); other cities keep their music. Known: a D2 car's front wheel can look too big/off its arch (wheel tables, next engine step). Night traffic = b15 (LA cars).
